title: Covered Length
difficulty: Medium
position: 10
complexity: O(n log n)
=== statement
Painters each paint a stretch of a long wall, from position `l` to position `r`. Stretches may overlap or touch. Joining all stretches that overlap or touch gives separate painted blocks. Count the blocks and the total painted length.
=== input
The first line has `n`. Each of the next `n` lines has a stretch `l r`.
=== output
Print the number of blocks and the total painted length.
=== constraints
1 <= n <= 65536
0 <= l < r <= 10^9
=== sample
4
1 3
2 6
8 10
10 12
--- expected
2 9
=== sample
2
0 5
1 2
--- expected
1 5
=== test
